name: City Council Special Closed Session
agenda_text:
January 13, 2021
4:30
PM
Via Zoom Teleconference
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be conducted through video conference in compliance with the Governor's and LA County Health Official's emergency orders. The meeting will be called to order at 4:30 p.m. on Wednesday, January 13, 2021. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below along with instructions on how to attend the public meeting.
Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Friday, January 8, 2021, at 5:00 p.m.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87251651239
Zoom Meeting ID: 872 5165 1239
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 872 5165 1239#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS
CLOSED SESSION
This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the matters listed below pursuant to Government Codes § 54956 and 54957. . The Mayor or City Attorney will give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.
1.

City of Palos Verdes Estates v. Lucretia Duncan, et al
Superior Court Case No. 19TRCP00166
2.

i.

iii.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT
At the conclusion of the closed session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed session agenda to the open session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may deem appropriate.
ADJOURNMENT
i.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City?s website, not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2.? Dated this 8th day of January, 2021.
Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk

INCORPORATED 1939

  MINUTES
  OF THE JANUARY 13, 2021 SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called
to order by Mayor Kemps at 4:30 P.M. on January 11 , 2021 , notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information
to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web .zoom.us/j/87251651239
  Zoom Meeting ID : 872 5165 1239
  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code 872 5165 1239#

  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

CALL TO ORDER 4:31 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, and
  Murdock. Councilmember Roos joined at 5:08 p.m.
  ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti
APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember
  Murdock to approve the agenda.
  AYES:  Roos , Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS

James Duncan addressed the City Council.

CLOSED SESSION
This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matters listed below pursuant to Government Codes§ 54956 and 54957.

1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code section §54956(d)(l)
  City of Palos Verdes Estates v. Lucretia Duncan, et al
  Superior Court Case No. 19TRCP00166

2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant to Government Code section §54957.6
   1.  Labor Negotiation process and procedure: J. Scott Tiedemann, Liebert Cassidy
  Whitmore
  ii.  Agency Representative: J. Scott Tiedemann, Liebert Cassidy Whitmore
  Represented Employee Group(s) : Public Service Employees and Palos Verdes
  Police Officers Association
  iii.  Agency Representative: City Manager Laura Guglielmo Unrepresented
  Employee Groups: Management/Administration and Professional/Supervisory
  Unrepresented Group

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

The City Council went into closed session from 4:32 to 5:46 p.m.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

Item 1. City Attorney Cotti reported that the City Council was presented with a settlement offer,
considered the terms and voted to reject the settlement offer.
Item 2. City Attorney Cotti reported that the City Council gave direction to the City Manager.

ADJOURNMENT

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, Seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to adjourn the meeting.
  AYES:  Roos , Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  u
Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor
